title: experiment test EXP-01 fails deterministically on a developer Mac: invalid_completion !== completed
observation: test/experiment.test.ts EXP-01 reports status `invalid_completion` where `completed` is expected when `npm test` runs inside a Claude Code session on a Mac; green in CI. 2026-09-20 narrowing: with the initiator variables removed (`env -u CLAUDECODE -u CODEX_THREAD_ID -u CODEX_SESSION_ID -u HUNCH_INITIATOR npm test`) both EXP-01 tests PASS on the combined 8-PR tree, and so does test/autoreview-cli.test.ts — so the cause is inherited host environment, the same family as the auto-review provider leak (issue #378 / fnd_5ae0e1edf5), not a product regression. Which variable, and where the experiment runner reads it, is still untraced. Tracked as GitHub issue #379.
evidence: 2026-09-20 pre-merge audit: one of the 7 failures reproducing identically on plain origin/main afe7870b with CLAUDECODE=1 inherited
